claims.statement: Illustrations of regular and semi regular solids for Luca Pacioli's De divina proportione. Manuscript copies are dated 1498, and the printed book appeared in 1509.

sources.cite: First chronology draft (Leonardo Chronology, 2026-10-09), entered from model recall. Basis stated in the draft: Pacioli's dedications; surviving copies.
